name: mdvsp-ts-set-partitioning-master
description: Extended set-partitioning (route-based / Dantzig-Wolfe) reformulation of the MDVSP-TS solved by branch-and-price. A column is a feasible vehicle route (an ordered sequence of trips for one depot) with a precomputed cost; the master selects a minimum-cost set of routes covering each trip exactly once. Columns are generated by a per-depot resource-constrained shortest-path pricing problem over a connection network, where the time-shifting window (maxDeviation) is the resource handled in the label start-time. Branching is done on color (depot assignment), inter-task arcs, and most-fractional arcs. The master LP relaxation is what is actually solved at each B&P node.

indices.name: T
indices.description: set of timetabled trips to cover

indices.name: Omega
indices.description: set of generated feasible routes (columns) across all depots

indices.name: trips_r
indices.description: ordered set of trips covered by route r

indices.name: arcs_r
indices.description: connection-network arcs traversed by route r (used for branching/forbidden-arc filtering)

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: cost of route r = 2*FIXED_COST (one vehicle) + VARIABLE_COST * (total pull-out + deadhead + pull-in travel time along the route) [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: covering coefficient: 1 if route r covers trip t, else 0 [domain {0,1}]

parameters.name: FIXED_COST
parameters.description: fixed cost per vehicle leg (pull-out and pull-in each pay it) [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: VARIABLE_COST
parameters.description: variable cost per minute of driving [domain Z_>=0]

parameters.name: maxDeviation
parameters.description: trip-shifting window used as the time resource in the pricing label-setting feasibility check [domain Z_>=0]

variables.name: lambda
variables.description: fraction/number of times route r is selected; relaxed to continuous in the master LP solved at each B&P node (integrality enforced by branching, not by the variable type)

constraints.name: trip_cover_partitioning
constraints.description: each trip must be covered by exactly one selected route (set-partitioning covering constraint; built as an equality == 1)

objective.name: objective
objective.description: minimize total cost of the selected routes
